Fix for ScotiaConnect “Current Day Account Activity” PDFs:
The first line’s direction now comes from the debit and credit totals at the bottom of the page. A transfer out is no longer read as money in.
The bottom totals are read as totals and checked against the lines, instead of being added to the last line’s description.
The period now uses the dates of the transactions themselves, not the 1st of the month.
